lines.text: Jesus says blind guides fall into a pit, and a fully trained disciple will be like his teacher.
Jesus calls someone a hypocrite for offering to remove a brother's speck while a beam is in his own eye.
Jesus says the mouth speaks from the overflow of the mind, and asks why people call Him Lord but disobey.
The man who hears and acts built on sand, and the torrent could not shake his house.
